plan.notes: Iowa State University 2026-2027 catalog, Computer Science B.S. official Four Year Plan (catalog page 'Four Year Plan' tab). Credit ranges recorded at catalog minimum: World Language 1010/1020 3-4 cr recorded as 3, free electives 2-3 cr recorded as 2; plan total 120-123, transcribed minimum 120. COMS 1010 Orientation is a 0-credit required course (required_zero). Generic breadth slots (Social Science, Arts and Humanities, natural science sequence, World Language, Statistics/Math/English/ComS electives) are recorded as choice placeholders using the official plan's slot labels. The degree requirements number the senior project COMS 4020C; the four-year plan labels it COMS 4020 (same 3-credit course).
